operation.description: The operation to perform: save (persist world), load (restore world), diff (compare two versions), update (evolve world)

checkpoint_name.description: Name of the checkpoint (for save/load operations)

world.description: World object to save (for save operation)

updates.description: Array of update operations (for update operation)

value.description: Value to add or update with

reason.description: Reason for this change (goes into changelog)

current_checkpoint.description: Current checkpoint to load and update (for update operation)
